title: Law Enforcement Disrupts Gootloader, CastleRAT, and StealC Infrastructure
description: Law enforcement agencies from multiple countries have disrupted the infrastructure of the Gootloader, CastleRAT, and StealC malware families as part of Operation Endgame. The takedown involved seizing 235 servers and 257 domains, and recovering 6.4 million victim credentials. Gootloader, active since at least 2018, operated as a dropper for ransomware and other malware, infecting over 25,000 computers and causing significant financial damage. CastleRAT, a remote access trojan active since 2025, enabled ransomware deployment by providing attackers control over infected machines. StealC, active since 2023, focused on stealing passwords, data, and identities. The disruption has severely crippled these malware operations and their distribution networks. The stolen credentials have been shared with multiple cybersecurity organizations to aid in victim notification and further defense efforts.
